show.description: Married to a Mystery is a romantic drama filled with twists, comedy, and emotions. The story follows Janya, a free-spirited girl who dreams of marrying only when her heart truly rings with love. A chance encounter with the charming Raj leads to a whirlwind marriage, but behind Raj’s simplicity hides a powerful secret. As Janya navigates love, family pressures, and her complicated past, shocking truths unravel one by one. Will their bond survive the lies, conspiracies, and hidden identities, or will fate tear them apart?
